evidence: The hafnium oxide films were deposited by the RPALD method on p-type Si substrates with 100 orientation and 6–1 2 cm resistivity, using TDEAH as the hafnium precursor and oxygen plasma as the oxidizing agent. A cycle of the deposition process consisted of 2 s of TDEAH supply, 1 min of Ar purge, 5 s of O2 plasma, and 1 min of Ar purge.
